data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 2.959 million in 2019, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This release represents a 0.31% reduction of the opening gross claims outstanding. While the overall gross movement was a release, the net movement note indicated mixed development across lines of business, with releases in property, marine, and miscellaneous, but strengthenings in third party liability and reinsurance acceptances. No specific events were identified as driving the prior year development.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is calculated from the gross claims development triangle as no explicit gross prior year movement figure was provided in narrative or movement notes. The narrative and a specific note refer to a net prior period reserve release of GBP 4.6 million, which differs from the gross calculated figure. Exact reserve text for gross prior year movement is not available as it was calculated from a table. No gross line of business breakdown for prior year development was available; the provided LOB breakdown on page 18 is explicitly net of reinsurance.
